integrity: Proof uses classical uniqueness of the maximum-volume inscribed ellipsoid. The numerical checks are supplementary, not independent verification or infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Only one-vertex parallel truncations of full-dimensional simplices in dimensions d>=3 are covered; the limit a->1 is not full-dimensional. Historical priority is not exhaustively established.
title: A sharp John-ellipsoid contact transition and strict volume-ratio ordering for simplex frusta
